long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Petah Tikva, Israel, Arbib worked internationally before moving to Italy in 2000. He created the online property marketplace Casaclick.it and sold it to Pirelli, then took charge of Elitrade. He directed valuation, acquisition, disposal and portfolio-subdivision work as the advisory company adopted the Colliers brand, ultimately spending eight years as its chief executive.

With his advisory platform established, Arbib joined partners to acquire Antirion SGR and became its chief executive. In 2022 Colliers purchased controlling stakes in both Antirion and the affiliated Italian advisory operations. Arbib continued to lead the investment manager, kept a significant shareholding under the group's partnership model and remained a co-principal of the wider national business. His career therefore links entrepreneurship, commercial-property services, institutional fund management and long-term equity ownership.
